title: Mommy Got Sick
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Eleven
verse: "I was sick, and ye visited me…"

pages.text:
Mommy always made the breakfast, always packed the bags,
always found the missing shoes and washed the dirty rags.

But one gray morning Mommy stayed beneath the blanket tight —
her nose was red, her head was hot, her voice was not quite right.

"Mommy's sick," she croaked. "I'm sorry. I can't get up today."
And Pip said, "Sick? But Mommy, you're the one who makes it okay!"

Then Jojo looked at Pip, and Pip looked back at Jojo too —
if Mommy couldn't take care of them… then what were they to do?

So Jojo got the cereal, and Pip got out the spoons,
and Baby Bee brought Mommy every one of her balloons.

They whispered in the hallway so their Mommy's head could rest,
and Biscuit lay beside her bed and guarded her his best.

Pip brought a glass of water. Jojo brought a book.
And Baby Bee climbed up to give one long and worried look.

"Mommy, does it hurt?" asked Jojo. "Just a little bit," she said.
"I'll be better soon. My body needs a day in bed."

"But you're the Mommy," Pip said. "Mommies don't get sick!"
And Mommy laughed a scratchy laugh that came out kind of thick.

"Oh, Mommies catch the sniffles, Pip. We get the fevers, too.
We need some soup and rest and care — the very same as you.

When you were sick, I held your hand and sang you songs at night.
Today you're taking care of me — and you are doing it right."

So Jojo read a story, slow, and Pip sang her a tune,
and Baby Bee fell fast asleep right in the afternoon.

Then two days later Mommy woke up singing, feeling strong,
and hugged them tight: "You took such care of me the whole day long!"

Because your Mommy cares for you the whole year through and through —
and Mommy needs some caring sometimes… because she's human too.

verses: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up.
Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
